replies.author: @DW-lh6rd
replies.text:
@E@ExploreTravelDocsech republic, Romania, Hungary, Croatia, even Greece.
Obviously anywhere tourist go the price goes up, so just move a few streets away from the big attractions and prices drop.
I’m currently in Cascais, Portugal. Been here many times over the past 25 years. Prices aren’t what they used to be. It’s expensive if you stay and eat at popular places.
Uber is still relatively cheap for some reason.
